title: Norma Dumont Faces Ailin Perez in Featured UFC Fight
seoTitle: Norma Dumont vs. Ailin Perez: Featured UFC Fight
subtitle: The matchup could determine the backup for queen Kayla Harrison
excerpt: The fight between Norma Dumont and Ailin Perez, scheduled for UFC Vegas 121, could have implications beyond the title.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The matchup between Norma Dumont and Ailin Perez, scheduled for UFC Vegas 121, could have repercussions that go beyond the bantamweight title. A victory for Perez would position her as the backup for Kayla Harrison's fight against Amanda Nunes, who already faces the possibility of a replacement should any issues arise.

What changed on the UFC calendar

The UFC announced that on November 14, New York City will host UFC 334, featuring two title fights on the main card. Before Josh Hokit challenges Ciryl Gane, the co-main event will be the matchup between Kayla Harrison and Amanda Nunes, who is returning from retirement. Harrison's fight was canceled in January due to an injury, and the organization already has Ailin Perez prepared to step in should anything prevent the duo from competing.

Why the Dumont vs. Perez fight is important

The clash between Dumont and Perez could determine who will be ready to serve as Harrison's replacement. Perez has already stated that she is prepared to fight not only for the belt, but also to take on the backup role. In an interview with Hablemos MMA, she commented that "Kayla is recovering from neck surgery and Amanda is older, so if someone gets hurt during the weight cut or something happens, someone needs to be ready."

The bantamweight landscape in 2026

With the matchup between Dumont and Perez set for the weekend, the UFC Vegas 121 main card will feature Raul Rosas Jr. against Raoni Barcelos. The fight between Dumont and Perez is the final step before Rosas Jr. and Barcelos face each other for the title. A victory for Perez would also place her in the division's top five, reinforcing her position as a contender.

What to expect from the matchup

Ailin Perez, who already has a winning streak, will seek her seventh consecutive victory by defeating Dumont. Dumont, on the other hand, aims to prevent Perez from advancing to the next stage of the championship. The bout promises to be tense, with both fighters looking to show they are ready for the next challenge.

Conclusion of the card

With UFC 334 in sight and the possibility of a backup for Harrison's fight, the matchup between Dumont and Perez gains even more relevance. A victory for Perez would place her in the backup position, while Dumont would have the chance to consolidate her position as a major contender. The outcome will be decisive for the planning of the November event.

With information from Bloody Elbow, UFC.com.
